scenes.text: One late chip shipment: eight builds blocked, sixty-seven orders slipping, twenty-nine dealers waiting on answers.
scenes.caption: 1 late shipment = 8 builds blocked, 67 orders, 29 dealers

scenes.text: Ops messages are messy. An AI agent that guesses an order ID, or what next Friday means, breaks things with total confidence.
scenes.caption: Messy messages + a guessing LLM = confident mistakes

scenes.text: So in HIGHWAY dot EXE, the model only reads. A local Qwen3 4B and a grammar reader both read every message. Neither outputs IDs or actions.
scenes.caption: The model only reads: local Qwen3 4B + a grammar reader

scenes.text: Each reading is grounded in a seventeen-thousand-node knowledge graph, from supplier to customer.
scenes.caption: Grounded in a 17,120-node knowledge graph

scenes.text: Then code plans the fix, and proves it three ways: ten handbook rules, a digital twin dry run, and a SQL recount. Only then do tools fire.
scenes.caption: Code decides. 3 proofs before any tool fires: ICE · TWIN · SQL

scenes.text: When it isn't sure, it doesn't guess. Rumors go to a human, with a checklist of what's missing.
scenes.caption: Not sure? It escalates to a human instead of guessing

scenes.text: Fifteen of fifteen events pass the audit. Eight hundred seventy-nine tool calls, zero failed. HIGHWAY dot EXE: every action carries its own proof.
scenes.caption: 15/15 audit pass · 879 tool calls · 0 failed · 61.6 s
